entities.summary: Johan Philip Lansberge was a Flemish Calvinist Minister, astronomer and Mathematician. His name is sometimes written Lansberg, and his first name is sometimes given as Philip or  Johannes Philippus. He published under the Latin name Philippus Lansbergius.
